title: Fall Prevention Program
subtitle: A practical, progressive exercise framework for fall prevention program, tailored to healthy aging.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the effectiveness of multifactorial exercise programs incorporating balance and strength training in reducing falls among older adults. Emerging evidence suggests benefits from telehealth delivery and dual-task training. Safety data conclusively support supervised progression and environmental modifications to minimize injury risk.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
